title: A Major Bajor World - Meta Clues

cards.a: Alaska - Camera Meta - Gen 4 coverage
cards.note: Generation 4 coverage in Alaska is concentrated around the city of Anchorage.

cards.a: Alaska - Camera Meta - Shitcam
cards.note: Shitcam is only found around Anchorage and Fairbanks, and parts of the road that connects them.

cards.a: Alaska - Coverage Meta - Taylor (East of Chicken)
cards.note: Taylor Highway (5), from the Yukon border to Tetlin Junction, can be recognized by the foggy, rainy weather, and Generation 2 camera. East of Chicken, the road is unpaved.

cards.a: Alaska - Coverage Meta - Taylor (West of Chicken)
cards.note: Taylor Highway (5), from the Yukon border to Tetlin Junction, can be recognized by the foggy, rainy weather, and Generation 2 camera. West of Chicken, the road is paved.

cards.a: American Samoa - Car Meta - Manu'a Car
cards.note: The front of a silver-grey truck with side mirrors can be seen on Manu’a and Olosega, which are connected by a bridge.

cards.a: American Samoa - Car Meta - Tau Car
cards.note: The front of a similar truck can be seen on the easternmost covered island of Tau. However, the truck will be glossy black, with side mirrors visible.

cards.a: American Samoa - Car Meta - Tutuila Car
cards.note:
A slightly rusted black truck bed can be seen on the main island of Tutuila.

This is the most common car that will be seen as it has the most coverage.

cards.a: Argentina - Car Meta - Sawdust Car Meta
cards.note: The “sawdust” car is found in centre-south Argentina and has a unique sandy dust on its visible black back.

cards.a: Argentina - Coverage Meta - Low Quality Sunset Coverage
cards.note: Sunset coverage with degraded image quality is found on the RN40 just south of the Mendoza border with Neuquén.

cards.a: Argentina - Coverage Meta - Melted Snow Coverage
cards.note: Melting snow coverage is seen on the eastern RN293 close to the Chilean border in southwestern Santa Cruz.

cards.a: Argentina - Coverage Meta - Snow Coverage
cards.note: This snow coverage is found on the eastern RP25 in eastern Santa Cruz.

cards.a: Argentina - Coverage Meta - Sunrise Coverage with Blurs
cards.note: Sunrise coverage with bad image quality and multiple blurs is found on a short part of the RN251 and RN22, west of Río Colorado.

cards.a: Australia - Car Meta - Open Trunk Meta
cards.note: The town of Gascoyne Junction in Western Australia is distinct, as the driver left the car boot open while covering this town, creating a very unique car meta.

cards.a: Australia - Car Meta - Snorkel Car
cards.note:
Australia is home to dozens of rare Google cars, which can usually be found in natural reserves.

Most rare Google cars with snorkels are located in New South Wales and the Australian Capital Territory. The only snorkel cars outside of NSW are in the northwestern part of Wunaamin Conservation Area (northern WA) and along Lucky Bay (south coastal WA).

cards.a: Australia - Car Meta - Wire Car Meta
cards.note: On most of the Northern Territory section of the Barkly Highway and a small part of the Queensland section, a wire can be seen on the left side of the car.

cards.a: Australia - Coverage Meta - Gen 2
cards.note: Generation 2 coverage cannot be found in Northern Territory. It can also help in 50/50s between Victoria and Tasmania, where Gen 2 is more common in Tasmania.

cards.a: Australia - Coverage Meta - Gen 2 Twig Meta
cards.note: In Generation 2 coverage in an area of Eastern NSW, a twig is visible in the Generation 2 halo.

cards.a: Australia - Coverage Meta - Gen 2 Whole Leaf
cards.note: In a lot of Generation 2 around the towns of Morwell and Traralgon in Eastern Victoria, an entire leaf is visible in the Generation 2 halo. A version with only the top half of a leaf can also be seen in eastern SA.

cards.a: Australia - Coverage Meta - Half Leaf
cards.note: The upper half of a leaf can sometimes be seen on the Generation 2 halo in southeastern South Australia. If it's an entire leaf, it is in Eastern Victoria.

cards.a: Australia - Coverage Meta - Jervis Bay Meta
cards.note: Jervis Bay only has Gen 1 coverage, all of which has a 2021 copyright.

cards.a: Australia - Coverage Meta - Smoke Coverage
cards.note: Around the Devils Marbles, north of Davenport in the Northern Territory, smoke from a bushfire is visible.

cards.a: Australia - Coverage Meta - Splodgey Sun
cards.note: A sun with "splodges" around it can be observed on the 95 in Western Australia, between Newman and Ex Doolgunna.

cards.a: Brazil - Car Meta - Noronha Car Meta
cards.note: Ilha de Fernando de Noronha is covered by a white buggy which sometimes has a visible front.

cards.a: Brazil - Coverage Meta - Amapa Blur
cards.note: In all Generation 4 coverage in Amapá, the front right of the camera is smudged. In addition, all Generation 4 coverage in Amapá features the white car with the blue stripe.

cards.a: Brazil - Coverage Meta - BR-156 in Northern Amapa
cards.note: This road is characterized by the Amapa Blur (slight blur at the front of a blue-striped car), the red, and the road angle to Northwest. There are frequently Areca palms growing near this road.

cards.a: Brazil - Coverage Meta - Camera Glitch
cards.note: Northwest Rio Grande do Sul has coverage with this camera glitch in Generation 3.

cards.a: Brazil - Coverage Meta - East-West BR156 in Amapa
cards.note: This part of the BR156 can be recognized by the Amapa Blur (slight blur at the front right of the blue-striped car). It's the only Amapa Blur coverage on a road that goes East-West. This part of the road is paved.

cards.a: Brazil - Coverage Meta - Flooded Coverage
cards.note: Flooded coverage can be found between Macau and Macauzinho in Rio Grande do Norte.

cards.a: Brazil - Coverage Meta - Hazy Sky
cards.note: Hazy Sky Coverage is very common in Porto Velho.

cards.a: Brazil - Coverage Meta - Post Bushfire Coverage
cards.note: The road between Caico, RGDN and Santa Luzia, Paraiba is unique with its post bushfire coverage. The part in Paraiba often has outer dashed lines

cards.a: Brazil - Coverage Meta - Rifts
cards.note: You can often see rifts in Alagoas Generation 3 coverage.

cards.a: Car Meta - 2 Zipties
cards.note: 2 clearly visible zip-ties can be found on a few roads in the southwest. Notably most of the 39 and its many sideroads, southeast of Ubar, southern 43, and the westernmost roads.

cards.a: Car Meta - Antenna facing camera
cards.note:
An antenna that is facing towards the camera is found all over the north.

Note by MB: This antenna can further be divided by the wire on the left side of the truck. BUT: If you're playing NMPZ and can't see the wire, it's still worth knowing where this antenna is found in general.

cards.a: Car Meta - Antenna facing camera - Big Wire Loop
cards.note:
The backwards-facing antenna can be further divided into smaller areas based on the type of wire present on the bar.

A wire that loops around the bar is found around Al Suwayq.

cards.a: Car Meta - Antenna facing camera - No Car
cards.note:
The backwards-facing antenna can be further divided into smaller areas based on the type of wire present on the bar.

If the car is mostly or entirely blurred, you are in

  • North Al Buraymi
  • North Al Dhahirah
  • South of Al Suwayq

cards.a: Car Meta - Antenna facing camera - No Wire
cards.note:
The backwards-facing antenna can be further divided into smaller areas based on the type of wire present on the bar.

No wire at all is found in the northwest.

cards.a: Car Meta - Antenna facing camera - Small Wire Loop
cards.note:
The backwards-facing antenna can be further divided into smaller areas based on the type of wire present on the bar.

A small looping wire in front of the bar is mainly in the east, starting in Muscat and Ad Dhakiliyah

cards.a: Car Meta - Antenna facing camera - Wire on Bar
cards.note:
The backwards-facing antenna can be further divided into smaller areas based on the type of wire present on the bar.

A wire following the bar is found on the roads that make an A-shape on the map, and on the Al Batinah/Al Dhahirah border.

cards.a: Car Meta - Coiled Cable - Flat
cards.note:
Coiled Cable can be found in Coastal Al Batinah South, and in North Eastern Ash Sharqiyah South.

The cable can have several shapes but remains easy to identify.

Al Batinah South is very flat and more residential

cards.a: Car Meta - Coiled Cable - Mountainous
cards.note:
Coiled Cable can be found in Coastal Al Batinah South, and in North Eastern Ash Sharqiyah South.

The cable can have several shapes but remains easy to identify.

Ash Sharqiyah South is more mountainous or flat with distant mountains

cards.a: Car Meta - Double Laying Antenna
cards.note: Mostly found at the same places as single laying antenna but sometimes on different (sections of) roads.

cards.a: Car Meta - Forward Facing Antenna
cards.note: A forwards-facing antenna is only found in and around Muscat.

cards.a: Car Meta - Full Blurred Car
cards.note:
You might still be able to kind off make out the colour but there shouldn’t be any parts of the car fully visible except for (usually) the antenna.

In the North, it can be found West of Muscat. In the South, it can be found on the 31 in Al Wusta, on the 45 & 47 and around Salalah.

cards.a: Car Meta - Gen 3; Red Car; Long Antenna
cards.note: A red Generation 3 car with a long antenna can be seen in and east of Melbourne.

cards.a: Car Meta - Left Cut Ziptie
cards.note:
There are two visible zip ties, but the left one is cut.

Cannot be found in Musandam, Muscat, Al Dhahirah, Al Batinah South. In Al Buraimi, it's only found North of Al Ain. In Al Batinah North, it's only found in the eastern half.

cards.a: Car Meta - No Right Ziptie, Wire behind Bar
cards.note:
No right zip tie but the wire is arranged differently so that it passes behind the back of the metal bar.

Can be found West of Muscat.

cards.a: Car Meta - Right Tilted Antenna
cards.note: An antenna bent to the right is found all over the south, as well as a few pockets in the north, notably northeast of El Ain, west of Al Suwayq, and around Bidiyah.

cards.a: Car Meta - Semi-Blurred Car
cards.note:
Less blurred than the normal blurred. Parts of the car are still fully visible, usually the front but sometimes the sides too.

It can be found around Muscat.

cards.a: Car Meta - Straight Antenna
cards.note: A regular-looking antenna that faces upwards is mainly found around and west of Muscat, as well as on highways in the northwest. A few other pockets include Al Buraimi and Sohar.

cards.a: Chile - Car Meta - Conguillo National Park
cards.note: Conguillio National Park can be recognized by this white truck with visible side mirrors and an antenna on the front right.

cards.a: Chile - Car Meta - Puerto Williams
cards.note:
Puerto Williams, the southernmost town covered by street view, can be recognized by this white pickup truck with visible side mirrors.

NOTE: The Puerto Williams coverage is located fairly far away from the normal car coverage in Chile. The nearest normal car coverage is in Fuerte Bulnes, near Punta Arenas.

cards.a: Chile - Car Meta - Toyota Hilux
cards.note: A grey Toyota Hilux, with various gear loaded and a snorkel on the front right, can be seen from around Baños Morales.

cards.a: Chile - Car Meta - Trailer
cards.note: The Google car can be seen towing a white and silver trailer with the word ‘Outback’ north of the Chilean National Zoo in Santiago.

cards.a: Chile - Coverage Meta - Autumn Coverage
cards.note: Southern Aysén can be recognised by autumn coverage, having orange and red coloured vegetation. Keep in mind that not all coverage in this region will have fall colours.

cards.a: Chile - Coverage Meta - B-710
cards.note:
More Generation 4 Sunset coverage can be seen on B-710 and Ruta 5.

On the B-710, a slight ridge can be seen to the west, while Ruta 5 is more open. Make sure to use the road angle or other clues before guessing.

cards.a: Chile - Coverage Meta - Ruta 5
cards.note:
More Generation 4 Sunset coverage can be seen on B-710 and Ruta 5.

On the B-710, a slight ridge can be seen to the west, while Ruta 5 is more open. Make sure to use the road angle or other clues before guessing.

cards.a: Colombia - Car Meta - Gen 3 - white/blue striped car
cards.note: Gen 3 with the white-blue car follows a straight line between Cartagena and Medellín, has partial coverage along Route 80 west of Bosconia, as well as along Route 45 north of Bucaramanga and east of Medellín.

cards.a: Colombia - Car Meta - Gen 4 - Grey Car
cards.note: Gen 4 coverage with the grey car is not found north of Montería, has a gap between Bucaramanga and Bogotá, forms a 'staircase' pattern with right angles at Medellín and Bogotá, covers areas around Bucaramanga, and has a missing section around Popayán.

cards.a: Colombia - Car Meta - Gen 4 - White Car
cards.note: Gen 4 with the white car has no coverage south of Cali, very little around Medellín, and forms a curved pattern around Medellín.

cards.a: Colombia - Car Meta - Leticia
cards.note:
This unique vehicle can be found in and around Leticia, the Southernmost town in Colombia.

NOTE: The long concrete blocks seen in the bottom left corner are a reliable way of recognising the road North of Leticia.

cards.a: Colombia - Car Meta - Providencia
cards.note: The island of Providencia, located roughly 90 kilometres North of San Andrés, is home to this unique grey truck.

cards.a: Colombia - Car Meta - San Andres
cards.note: Coverage on the Caribbean island of San Andrés was taken by this distinct white car.

cards.a: Colombia - Coverage Meta - "Gen 5" Glitch
cards.note: A camera glitch that makes a part of the image look very saturated can be found in southern Colombia.

cards.a: Colombia - Coverage Meta - Arauca Rift
cards.note: On the road in Arauca and in the city of Arauca in northeastern Colombia, there is virtually only cloudy, bad weather coverage. Furthermore, there was a small camera glitch where you can see this small rift northeast of the driving direction.

cards.a: Colombia - Coverage Meta - Double Google Car
cards.note: A Second Google Car is visible in many random spots. The most prominent spots are the 26 in Cauca, Vda. Chontaduro (near Popoyan) and the road between Pital and Tarqui.

cards.a: Colombia - Coverage Meta - Double Google Car - Aguachica
cards.note: This instance of a second google car can be seen on Carrera 4, an offroad of the 45 near Aguachica.

cards.a: Colombia - Coverage Meta - Double Google Car - Villavicencio
cards.note: This instance of a second google car can be seen on the east-west road, directly south of Guayuriba River, which is south of Villavicencio.

cards.a: Colombia - Coverage Meta - Embalse Calima
cards.note: Large lake, mostly winter coverage. A small stretch also has summer coverage.

cards.a: Colombia - Coverage Meta - Foggy & Rainy Coverage
cards.note: If you see rainy coverage, combined with strong fog, you're on the 64.

cards.a: Colombia - Coverage Meta - Grey Car, 2023 copyright
cards.note: This constellation can be found on the 65 in Caqueta and the 45 in Putumayo.

cards.a: Colombia - Coverage Meta - La Florida
cards.note: Rainy coverage with very orange-brown soil can be found on this road to La Florida.

cards.a: Colombia - Coverage Meta - Rainy Coverage
cards.note: Rainy coverage is most common on the highways 20, 24, 50 and 64.

cards.a: Colombia - Coverage Meta - Sogamoso Lake
cards.note: If you see a lake, paired with an overexposed Gen 4 camera, you're probably on this lake south of Sogamoso.

cards.a: Colombia - Coverage Meta - Stick Meta
cards.note: This stick on the camera can be found between El Guio and El Boral (near the Cundinamarca-Meta border near Villavicencio)

cards.a: Colombia - Coverage Meta - Unique Road - Tame to Arauca
cards.note: On this road, you can see a sunset through the clouds. It's not always easy to recognize, however.

cards.a: Colombia - Coverage Meta - Unique Road - Tame to Hato Corozal
cards.note: On this road, you can see a slight sunset through the clouds. It is pretty flat, with mountains in the Northwest.

cards.a: Coverage Meta - 29 south of Ibri
cards.note: Road 29 south of Ibri features a fairly shrubby landscape, with low and jagged mountains on the eastern side of the road. The low-lying sun to the northwest is particularly distinct.

cards.a: Coverage Meta - 37 (Sunset Coverage)
cards.note: Road 37 travels in a generally northwest direction through a very generic, flat desert landscape. The angle is one of the best clues for this road. On the northern half, you can find distinct sunset coverage.

cards.a: Coverage Meta - 42 south of Shalim
cards.note: Just south of Shalim, you’ll find a stretch of overcast coverage, along with a power line to the west of the road.

cards.a: Coverage Meta - 43 south of Ubar
cards.note: Road 43, also south of Ubar, is unpaved and features sunset coverage along with a dust trail behind the car.

cards.a: Coverage Meta - 45
cards.note: Roads 45 and the western stretch of 39 both feature a similar slightly hilly desert landscape, sunny weather, and a general east-to-west direction. What makes them unique is the light-coloured shoulders the roads share, though it is most pronounced on Road 45. The roads also mostly have a faded white middle line. To tell the 45 and western 39 apart, look at the sun, which is overhead on the 39, but to the west on 45. The section north of Mudayy is also the 45, but unlabelled on Google Maps.

cards.a: Coverage Meta - Dirty Gen 2 Halo
cards.note: In some of New South Wales’ Generation 2, the halo looks very dirty. This is most common west of ACT and south of Barrington Tops.

cards.a: Coverage Meta - Hazy Adam
cards.note: In and close to Adam, the coverage is usually quite hazy, and the ridge and hills from the previous tip can be seen to the north. Though sometimes, only one or two are visible. Unlike north of Adam, you won’t see mountains in any other direction.

cards.a: Coverage Meta - Max South 32
cards.note: The southernmost section of Road 32 has a somewhat hilly landscape. The puffy cumulus clouds are what make this stretch recognisable. You can also look for the power line that runs west of the road for confirmation.

cards.a: Coverage Meta - Max West 39
cards.note: Roads 45 and the western stretch of 39 both feature a similar slightly hilly desert landscape, sunny weather, and a general east-to-west direction. What makes them unique is the light-coloured shoulders the roads share, though it is most pronounced on Road 45. The roads also mostly have a faded white middle line. To tell the 45 and western 39 apart, look at the sun, which is overhead on the 39, but to the west on 45. The section north of Mudayy is also the 45, but unlabelled on Google Maps.

cards.a: Coverage Meta - Ruta 21
cards.note: Generation 4 sunset coverage can be seen on Ruta 21 from Calama to San Francisco de Chiu Chiu. In the west near Calama, the sun has just started to set, causing a giant white dome in the sky. In the east, the sky has a warm gradient, and the tops of the volcanoes are seen glowing pink.

cards.a: Coverage Meta - Western 41 - Cloudy
cards.note: The western stretch of Road 41 has wide shoulders similar to Road 31, however, the more northwest-bound angle along with the reddish soil should tell them apart. The eastern half has cloudy coverage.

cards.a: France - Car Meta - Rare Antenna - Black & White
cards.note:
On rare occasions, you may find a flag attached to the antenna in the generation 3 coverage. While much of the highlighted areas has been overwritten, learning the distribution of each antenna can yield very high scores.

The black/white flag can be found in Calvados, Orne, Eastern Bourgogne and Loire/Haut de Loire

cards.a: France - Car Meta - Rare Antenna - Blue
cards.note:
On rare occasions, you may find a flag attached to the antenna in the generation 3 coverage. While much of the highlighted areas has been overwritten, learning the distribution of each antenna can yield very high scores.

The blue flag can be found in Bas-Rhin, Aube and the Correze/Haute-Vienne/Dordogne Tristate

cards.a: France - Car Meta - Rare Antenna - Red
cards.note:
On rare occasions, you may find a flag attached to the antenna in the generation 3 coverage. While much of the highlighted areas has been overwritten, learning the distribution of each antenna can yield very high scores.

The red flag can be found in the eastern part of the Nord-Department

cards.a: Germany - Camera Meta - Low Cam
cards.note: Lowcam coverage can be found around Singen and near Switzerland.

cards.a: Germany - Car Meta - Gen 3 / Antenna
cards.note: This rare Generation 3 car coverage with an antenna can be found in central Hamburg (Speicherstadt). Note by MB: This is officially a trekker, so you won't find any copyright.

cards.a: Germany - Car Meta - Gen 3 Black Car
cards.note:
You can find a Generation 3 black car in this safari park southeast of Bielefeld.

You can commonly see 4x4s painted with a zebra pattern in the park.

NOTE: This car is unique to this park within all of Europe.

cards.a: Germany - Car Meta - White/Black Gen 4 Car
cards.note:
You can find this rare white and black Generation 4 car in Hamburg and around Frankfurt.

NOTE: You can also find the same car around London and in Ireland.

cards.a: Hawaii - Car Meta - Stubby Antenna
cards.note: This antenna can be found anywhere, but is most common Hawaii Island, then Kauai, then Oahu.

cards.a: Hawaii - Coverage Meta - Gen 2 Hawaii
cards.note: Generation 2 coverage can only be found on the islands of Hawaiʻi, Maui and Oʻahu.

cards.a: Hawaii - Coverage Meta - Gen 4 Hawaii
cards.note:
Generation 4 coverage can only be found on the islands of Hawaiʻi, Maui and Oʻahu.

Note by MB: This applies only to Gen 4, not to Smallcam, which can be found everywhere

cards.a: Hawaii - Coverage Meta - Green Blur
cards.note: Within Hawaii, a distinct green blur can only be seen on the island of Oʻahu.

cards.a: Iceland - Car Meta - Red Truck
cards.note:
Iceland can be split in half depending on the colour of the pickup truck, with red being found in the southwest, and white being found in the northeast.

The Red Truck is found between Sudurland and Vesturland

cards.a: Iceland - Car Meta - White Truck
cards.note: Iceland can be split in half depending on the colour of the pickup truck, with red being found in the southwest, and white being found in the northeast.

cards.a: India - Camera Meta - High Quality Shitcam
cards.note: The coverage on road NH326 (labelled 326) west of Brahmapur in Odisha has a thin grey antenna. The images are generally very high-quality for shitcam, with an especially high quality near the Harabhangi Reservoir.

cards.a: India - Car - Kuno National Park Car
cards.note: This car has a back curving bar, but is mostly blurred. It can be found east of Kuno National Park

cards.a: India - Car Meta - Andaman Car
cards.note: This is the most common, though not only car on Andaman.

cards.a: India - Car Meta - Arunachal Pradesh - Back Antenna
cards.note: Within Arunachal Pradesh, a back antenna can be found around Chowkam and East of Namsai.

cards.a: India - Car Meta - Arunachal Pradesh - White Car with Mirrors
cards.note: Within Arunachal Pradesh, a white car with mirrors can be found on the road west of Itanagar.

cards.a: India - Car Meta - Assam - Back Antenna
cards.note: If you see a back antenna in Assam, you're in the far east of the state.

cards.a: India - Car Meta - Black Car
cards.note: This is not something you will come across very often, but if you have a black car and don’t really know where to go/want to confirm your guess, black car is more common in Telangana/Andhra Pradesh, especially in Northern Telangana and Coastal AP.

cards.a: India - Car Meta - Black Goa Car
cards.note: This black car, uniquely characterized through the black bars on each the side, is only found in Goa.

cards.a: India - Car Meta - Boxy Car
cards.note: Large visible, square shaped cars can be found in all states northwest of Maharashtra and Uttar Pradesh, except for Madhya Pradesh. It can also be found in and around Hyderabad, Bengaluru and Chennai.

cards.a: India - Car Meta - Boxy Car - 5 Indents
cards.note: A boxy car with 5 indents can be found near the river mouth of the Subarnarekha river near the Odisha/WB border.

cards.a: India - Car Meta - Boxy Car - 6 Indents
cards.note: A boxy car with 6 indents is found near Malkangiri, Odisha.

cards.a: India - Car Meta - Boxy Car - Karnataka
cards.note: Boxy car in Karnataka is only found in and around Bengaluru.

cards.a: India - Car Meta - Boxy Car - Odisha
cards.note: A boxy car with an extra step at the front is found in Odisha.

cards.a: India - Car Meta - Flower Car
cards.note: A car with flowers on the front can be found around Keonjhar, on the 49 and the 20.

cards.a: India - Car Meta - Goa/Daman Car
cards.note: This car (note the antenna!) can be found in Goa, and in the Union Territory of Daman.

cards.a: India - Car Meta - Haryal Car
cards.note: This car is unique to Haryal, PB. It looks similar to the boxy car, but with a rounded front.

cards.a: India - Car Meta - Himachal Pradesh - Boxy Car
cards.note: Shimla is the only city in Himachal Pradesh to have a boxy car, which is this car with the top right corner visible with a thread (sometimes not visible).

cards.a: India - Car Meta - Jammu/Kashmir Car
cards.note:
White car, box car with bars and the central strap leaning right.

It can be found mainly in Jammu/Kashmir but sometimes in Sultanpur, UP.

cards.a: India - Car Meta - Ladakh Car
cards.note: All roads in Ladakh have this white car with visible front.

cards.a: India - Car Meta - Lakshadweep - Adidas Car
cards.note:
The "Adidas Car" is characterized by the black stripes on the white car front. Sometimes it has a visible side mirror. It also often has a visible bar at the back.

It is exclusive to the island of Amini

cards.a: India - Car Meta - Lakshadweep - Big Blur
cards.note: A big circular blur (either full blurred or transparently blurred) is very common in Retrocam. On Lakshadweep, however, it is only found on Andrott and Kalpeni (both also have a car that's unique for these islands respectively).

cards.a: India - Car Meta - Lakshadweep - Blurred Black Front
cards.note:
This car with the subtle black blur at the front is found in Kalpeni. The blur can be very subtle sometimes, and is confusable with the blurred white edges on Agatti.

Sometimes the same car has a slightly different blur, where the edges are exposed.

Kalpeni can also have a big circular blur, so don't rule out Kalpeni if you don't see this car.

cards.a: India - Car Meta - Lakshadweep - Blurred White Edges
cards.note: This car is mostly blurred and has subtle white edges at the front. It's found on the island of Agatti. Sometimes the edges are so subtle that you can overlook them and confuse it with the Kalpeni car (which has a subtle black blur)

cards.a: India - Car Meta - Lakshadweep - Exposed Black
cards.note: This car with an exposed black front is unique to Kiltan. Note that the front is always exposed on Kiltan, if it's blurred (even partly), it's not the Kiltan car.

cards.a: India - Car Meta - Lakshadweep - Red Car
cards.note:
The red front blur can be found on Andrott. Sometimes, the same car has a bit different blur, where there's some exposed red visible.

Note that Andrott can also have the big circular blur where you see no car.

cards.a: India - Car Meta - Lakshadweep - White Car with Mirror
cards.note: This car is the most likely to encounter if you get Lakshadweep. It has a white front and always a bit of mirror visible on the left. Sometimes a part of the mirror is blurred, but you can always see at least a bit of it exposed. This car is so common because it's on the main island of Lakshadweep, Kavaratti.

cards.a: India - Car Meta - Lakshadweep - White Exposed Front
cards.note: This car with an exposed white front is found of Kadmat. This car can be confused with others: It's not the Kadmat car if it has a visible side mirror. It's also not the Kadmat car if the front is blurred.

cards.a: India - Car Meta - Mechuka Car
cards.note: Mechuka features a unique car in Arunachal. It can be found in the valley and on the road leading to it from Along on the NH13.

cards.a: India - Car Meta - Mizoram - Double Mirror Car
cards.note: In Mizoram, a grey car with double mirrors appears in the southernmost coverage, near the NH502.

cards.a: India - Car Meta - Mizoram - Long Antenna
cards.note:
If you see a long antenna, combined with a black car front in Mizoram, you're on the NH6 north of Serkhan.

Keep in mind this car is not unique to Mizoram.

cards.a: India - Car Meta - Mizoram - Stubby Antenna
cards.note: A car with a black front and a stubby antenna within Mizoram can be found on the roads west of Aizawi.

cards.a: India - Car Meta - NH179B Car
cards.note: This car has an antenna with some kind of a spring. It basically goes from Salem to Chennai.

cards.a: India - Car Meta - Open Trunk
cards.note: In the eastern parts of Ajmer, RJ, you can sometimes see an open trunk in Smallcam. It can be found north of Shrinagar/west of Circular Rd.

cards.a: India - Car Meta - Orange Flag Car
cards.note: A car with an orange flag can be found in the Jharkhand north-east panhandle.

cards.a: India - Car Meta - Punjab - Black Boxy Car
cards.note: Within Punjab, the black boxy car can be found on the Pakistani border between Firozpur and Amritsar.

cards.a: India - Car Meta - Punjab - Dasuya Forest Car
cards.note: Within Punjab, this car is is unique to Dasuya Forest. Beware that this car is not unique to Punjab though.

cards.a: India - Car Meta - Punjab - Red Boxy Car
cards.note: Within Punjab, the red boxy car can be found in Ludhiana, Chandigarh, and a bit north between them. The coverage forms a reverse 'v'.

cards.a: India - Car Meta - Racecar
cards.note: This cool car with a spoiler at the back can be found in Max-North Andaman, near Daglipur.

cards.a: India - Car Meta - Rewa Car
cards.note: This car has a back curving bar at the front and white bars on the side. It's found mostly around Rewa, but also around Raipura.

cards.a: India - Car Meta - Roing Car
cards.note: Within Arunachal Pradesh, both this black and this red car are exclusively found in Roing. The black car appears mainly on the NH313 and east. The red car appears mainly west of the main road.

cards.a: India - Car Meta - Satpura National Park Car
cards.note: This car has a back-curving bar and a singular black bar. It's found mainly east of Satpura National Park, and sometimes around Raipura.

cards.a: India - Car Meta - Tezu-Lohitpur Road
cards.note: If you see this white, boxy-looking car in Arunachal Pradesh, you're on the road between Tezu and Lohitpur.

cards.a: India - Car Meta - Western Meghalaya Antenna
cards.note: In the very far western part of the Meghalaya, on the roads north of Purakhasia, you can find a particular car with an antenna on the top left. It can be quite hard to see so be aware it exists so you know what to look for

cards.a: India - Car Meta - White Goa Car with bar
cards.note: This white car, uniquely characterized through the bar on the side, which is black and grey, is only found in Goa.

cards.a: India - Car Meta - Yellow Car
cards.note:
While the car is blurred most of the time, Sikkim features a noticeable car that gives the western part of Sikkim, starting at Rangpo.

It can have an antenna, be blurred, almost invisible, but as long as you see a yellow car, you know it’s here.

cards.a: India - Coverage Meta - Andaman Vibes
cards.note:
Andaman Islands are remote Islands that have their own distinct vegetation. It is covered in areca palm forests and the roads are often very thin.

Andaman has been covered using a camera with maxed out saturation somehow. The result is these very bright/white colors.

cards.a: India - Coverage Meta - Kerala Construction Meta
cards.note:
In 2025, a large part of the NH-66 in Kerala is under construction, making it very recognizable.

If you see a long, straight highway with construction in Smallcam, you're likely to be on the NH-66.

cards.a: India - Coverage Meta - Tripura Cam
cards.note: Many locations in Tripura have a pretty low brightness, despite the sun being out and not setting.

cards.a: India - Coverage Meta - Yawal Double Smudge
cards.note: This double smudge can be found in the central-northern parts of the Yawal Wildlife Sanctuary in Madhya Pradesh.

cards.a: India - Misc - India Union Muslim League
cards.note:
Green flag with half moon and star, pointing at the top left corner.

This party is almost exclusively active in Kerala. Mostly in the districts of Kozhikode and Malappuram.

cards.a: Indonesia - Car Meta - Gen 3 Antenna
cards.note: Generation 3 antenna coverage is most commonly found on Java, but can very rarely be seen on Bali in and around Denpasar. It is most commonly seen in East Java, as most of the antenna coverage in the west has been overwritten by Generation 4.

cards.a: Indonesia - Car Meta - Gen 3 Black
cards.note: Black Generation 3 coverage can be found almost everywhere in Indonesia, but is most common in Sulawesi.

cards.a: Indonesia - Car Meta - Jagasatru Car
cards.note: A black cab with men sitting in the truck bed can be seen near Jagasatru on Bali.

cards.a: Indonesia - Car Meta - Wooden Plank Car
cards.note: A white SUV with black bars and a wooden plank on the roof can rarely be seen in eastern Bali.

cards.a: Indonesia - Coverage Meta - Pink Air
cards.note: In some of the Generation 4 coverage in the city of Batam, a purple tint and a black blurred object can be seen. Although this camera glitch is most commonly found in Batam, you may spot it in nearby regions such as North Sumatra, around Medan. Make sure to look out for other clues before guessing.

cards.a: Japan - Coverage Meta - Hokkaido Winter
cards.note: Hokkaido has very limited winter and snow coverage. Unless you are certain, it is often better not to guess this prefecture. Though, if you do find yourself in Hokkaido, these regions are most likely. Other low amounts of miscellaneous coverage is primarily in the southern half of the island.

cards.a: Mexico - Car Meta - Cofre de Perote Truck
cards.note: This white truck with visible rearview mirrors can be seen in the Cofre de Perote national park.

cards.a: Mexico - Car Meta - La Malinche Car
cards.note: This Street View car with a yellow hood can be found by the La Malinche volcano in Tlaxcala.

cards.a: Mexico - Car Meta - La Seca Car
cards.note: This red Street View car with a black roof can be found in the town of La Seca in Sinaloa.

cards.a: Norway - Coverage Meta - Snow Road
cards.note: The road between Atna and Ringebu in Innlandet is completely covered in snow. You will find a winter wonderland with green rocks

cards.a: Norway - Coverage Meta - Thick Snow Road
cards.note: This road between Aadneram and Nomeland in Agder features a thick 1m high snow along the skinny road. You will not find trees along this road.

cards.a: Peru - Car Meta - White Truck
cards.note: Within Peru, this white Street View car is found in central Cusco. It drives from the remote town of Aguas Calientes up to Machu Picchu.

cards.a: Philippines - Car Meta - General Santos Car
cards.note: You may find this black Street View car with a visible roof rack in and around the city of General Santos.

cards.a: Philippines - Car Meta - Mayon Vehicle
cards.note: This vehicle with several thick black bars can be found just south of the Mayon Volcano.

cards.a: Philippines - Car Meta - Orange Car
cards.note: An orange Street View car with visible side mirrors can be found on Corregidor Island.

cards.a: Philippines - Car Meta - Taped Car back
cards.note: In northwestern Bohol you can find this Street View car with tape on the back.

cards.a: South Africa - Car Meta - Kruger National Park Car
cards.note:
A camouflage car with black side mirrors and roof racks can be seen in Kruger National Park, on the Mozambique border.

NOTE: The Park now also has generation 4 coverage.

cards.a: Turkey - Car Meta - Truck Coverage
cards.note: Generation 4 truck coverage is mainly found in the far east of the country and along the southern coast, with smaller pockets in the west and around Kastamonu.

cards.a: Turkey - Coverage Meta - D525 south of Söke
cards.note: Road D525 south of Söke is a completely straight road going south-south-west to north-north-east with winter Generation 3 coverage. Along the road you will typically find a large amount of reed.

cards.a: Turkey - Coverage Meta - E99 south of Sanliurfa
cards.note: Road E99 south of Şanlıurfa is a divided highway which can be recognised by the slightly hazy Generation 4 sunrise coverage combined with the flat agricultural landscape and general south-north road angle.

cards.a: United States - Car Meta - Daniel Boone Car
cards.note:
This section of road in Daniel Boone National Forest near Beattyville, KY has a unique Google car.

Note by MB: This coverage is overwritten afaik.

cards.a: United States - Car Meta - Ford Bronco
cards.note:
As part of a promotional campaign, the TransAmerica Trail from Oregon to North Carolina was covered by a Ford Bronco. The car can recognised by its unblurred black roof and red hood, and is mostly found on unpaved rural roads.

Looking backwards, you will see two other Ford SUVs escorting the camera car.

cards.a: United States - Car Meta - Golden Gate Car
cards.note: This car can be found to the north of the Golden Gate Bridge in San Francisco.

cards.a: United States - Car Meta - Santa Catalina Car
cards.note: This island to the south of Los Angeles has a unique Google car.

cards.a: United States - Coverage Meta - Winter - Appalachians
cards.note: Within the Appalachians, Winter Coverage is most common in West Virginia.

cards.a: United States - Coverage Meta - Winter - New England
cards.note: Winter/fall coverage such as this is commonplace in New England, particularly in Massachusetts, Connecticut, and Rhode Island. Be aware that winter coverage also exists in the South and hence why you may get Arkansas or another state in that region mixed up with New England if you’re trying to go based only on the vibes.
